title: Exactness of the Cech sequence of a module for a principal open covering
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $f_1,\dots,f_n\in R$ elements generating the unit ideal, and $M$ an $R$-module. Then the sequence $0\to M\xrightarrow{\alpha}\bigoplus_{i=1}^nM_{f_i}\xrightarrow{\beta}\bigoplus_{i,j=1}^nM_{f_if_j}$ is exact, where $\alpha(m)=(m/1,\dots,m/1)$ and $\beta((m_i/f_i^{e_i})_i)=(m_i/f_i^{e_i}-m_j/f_j^{e_j})_{(i,j)}$ (the differences taken in $M_{f_if_j}$ via the canonical maps $M_{f_i}\to M_{f_if_j}$, $M_{f_j}\to M_{f_if_j}$). That is: $m\in M$ with $m/1=0$ in every $M_{f_i}$ is $0$, and every family $(s_i)\in\prod_iM_{f_i}$ whose images in $M_{f_if_j}$ agree for all $i,j$ is $(m/1)_i$ for a (unique) $m\in M$.
